name: Inquiry Acknowledgement Notification to Customer
script:
# Simple Lead Acknowledgment Email Script # Trigger: After Submit on Lead DocType # Get email from lead recipient_email = doc.get("email_id") if recipient_email: # Prepare customer name customer_name = doc.get("lead_name") or doc.get("first_name") or "Valued Customer" # Email subject subject = f"Thank You for Your Inquiry - Ref: {doc.name}" # Email message message = f"""

Thank You for Your Inquiry!

Dear {customer_name},

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your property inspection needs. We have received your inquiry and our team will review your requirements shortly.

Your Inquiry Details:

Reference Number: {doc.name}

Lead Type: {doc.get('type', 'Property Inspection')}

Job Type: {doc.get('custom_job_type', 'Not specified')}

Email: {doc.get('email_id', 'Not provided')}

Phone: {doc.get('mobile_no', 'Not provided')}

Budget Range: {doc.get('custom_budget_range', 'Not specified')}

Project Urgency: {doc.get('custom_project_urgency', 'Not specified')}

What Happens Next?

  • Our team will review your requirements within 24 hours
  • We'll prepare a customized inspection plan
  • You'll receive a detailed quotation and timeline
  • We'll schedule the inspection at your preferred time

If you have any questions, please contact us at info@yourcompany.com or call +1 (555) 123-4567.

Thank you for choosing us!

Best regards,
Your Property Inspection Team

""" # Send email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment to lead doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Acknowledgment email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for lead: {doc.name}", "Email Missing")
